Expected Result: System requests at least one subject.

Expected Result: Unavailable subject is rejected and cannot be registered.

Expected Result: Displayed total matches the configured fee for that subject.

Input / Steps: Select multiple subjects with configured fees
Expected Result: Displayed total matches the applicable fee rules.

Expected Result: Payment failure is shown; registration is not confirmed.

Expected Result: System shows the designed status and avoids duplicate charges on retry.

Input / Steps: Simulate server error during submission
